claims.claim: Desktop generation places all three valid candidates in a visibly dormant and unselected library.
claims.baselineEvidence: Fresh origin showed ARCHIVE DURABLE, AI OFF, and zero candidates.
claims.action: Loaded the starter proof, confirmed review, generated, and opened Archive.
claims.expectedVisibleChange: Three readable archive cards show DORMANT UNSELECTED and advisory purpose shelves.
claims.observedSequence: 0 objects -> 3 candidates -> 3 archive cards and 3 durable events.
claims.typedObservation: Balanced, guarded, and lean cards each showed development-repair, INFERRED_UNCONFIRMED, DORMANT, UNSELECTED, a package digest, and a handoff export control.

claims.claim: Selection is an overlay and the dormant library survives reload.
claims.baselineEvidence: Three cards were DORMANT UNSELECTED with 3 events.
claims.action: Selected the first compared candidate, reopened Archive, then reloaded the page and reopened Archive.
claims.expectedVisibleChange: One card becomes DORMANT SELECTED FOR REVIEW, two remain DORMANT UNSELECTED, and all three persist after reload.
claims.observedSequence: 3 objects/3 events -> one review selection/4 events -> reload -> same 3 objects/4 events.
claims.typedObservation: Candidate generation state reset to zero after reload while the durable archive independently retained all three objects and the selection event.

claims.claim: Dormant archive controls and cards remain readable on mobile.
claims.baselineEvidence: Reloaded persisted Archive state at desktop size.
claims.action: Applied the mobile viewport and scrolled from archive summary to all three cards.
claims.expectedVisibleChange: Actions wrap, cards stack, status labels and digests remain readable, and handoff buttons remain reachable.
claims.observedSequence: Mobile summary/action panel -> selected card -> two unselected cards.
claims.typedObservation: No horizontal clipping was visible; each card used a single column with a full-width handoff button.

claims.claim: The handoff action visibly preserves the authority ceiling.
claims.baselineEvidence: Archive card exposed Export dormant source handoff.
claims.action: Clicked the first handoff export control.
claims.expectedVisibleChange: The page reports export without execution, admission, installation, or registration.
claims.typedObservation: Notice read: dormant source handoff, no execution, admission, install, or registration.
claims.namedSeam: The browser controller's download-event observer timed out, so retained-file delivery is not claimed from visual evidence; payload correctness is proven separately by deterministic and CLI checks.

nextCheapestTest: Mike reviews whether any dormant organ should receive a separate governed implementation route.
